# GiftPo

> GiftPo is a platform designed to help you truly value the gifts you send and receive. Build deeper, more meaningful connections through thoughtful gifting.

## Overview
GiftPo is a smart mobile application available for iOS and Android that focuses on the sentimental value of gifting rather than just the management of items.

## Features
- **Nurture Gifts**: Easily keep track of all your wonderful gifts and nurture the relationships that matter most.
- **Accept Gifts**: Seamlessly accept and organize gifts sent by your loved ones without any stress or hassle.
- **Invite Friends**: Bring your friends on board to share the joy. The gifting experience is always better together.
